newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore oil exports rise in value in May on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore oil exports rise in value in May on year.

text.p: The value of Singapore's oil exports in May rose 7.9 percent from a year earlier and were up 18 percent from the month before, government data showed Friday.
In nominal terms, May exports totalled S$1.553 billion compared with S$1.314 billion in April. A year earlier figure was not detailed in the data.
However, the figures failed to change a short-term decline in export values, although the trend slowed.
The three month moving average fell 5.9 percent in May compared with a year earlier, slower than the 10.3 percent decline registered in April.
Singapore's Trade Development Board said the improving three-month performance was "due to higher shipments to Hong Kong and China".
